'''Saile Minnau''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[Resistance navy|Resistance fleet]] [[Resistance trooper|guard]] during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]]. After the [[fleet]] was [[Battle of Oetchi|destroyed]] following the [[Battle of D'Qar]] in [[34 ABY]], the survivors evacuated to the [[planet]] [[Crait]] to make a last stand. After the [[Resistance]] forces were forced to retreat within the [[Crait outpost|Rebel base]] they had occupied, Minnau was among those in the base who witnessed the [[Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker]] leave to confront the First Order alone. The Resistance survivors then escaped aboard the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''.

==Biography==
Saile Minnau was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[Resistance trooper|guard]] in the [[Resistance navy|fleet]] of the [[Resistance]] during its [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]].<ref name="TLJVD" /> In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' dates the [[Battle of D'Qar]] to fifty-three [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Proclamation of the New Order]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]. The Battle of [[D'Qar]] must therefore take place in [[34 ABY]].</ref> the [[fleet]] [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuated]] from the [[Resistance base]] on the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]] but was [[Battle of Oetchi|pursued]] by [[Starship|ships]] of the [[First Order Navy]] and destroyed vessel by vessel until the only [[capital ship]] remaining was the<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> [[MC85 Star Cruiser]] ''[[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|Raddus]]''.<ref name="TLJVD" /> Those on board the ''Raddus'' then evacuated on board [[U-55 orbital loadlifter]]s to the planet [[Crait]], where they occupied an old [[Crait outpost|Rebel outpost]] and prepared to make a last stand.<ref name="TLJ" />

[[File:WatchingDadGoToWork-TLJ.png|thumb|250px|left|Minnau, Kuchimba and Millham staring in confusion as Skywalker walks out of the base.]]
Minnau was among the Resistance forces who made it to the base, where they [[Battle of Crait|fought]] the First Order from the trenches and using [[V-4X-D ski speeder]]s before being forced to retreat back into the base once the First Order fired its [[superlaser siege cannon]]. As their enemy advanced, the Resistance learned that there was no reinforcements coming to aid them; however, just as hope seemed lost, [[Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker]] appeared in the base.<ref name="TLJ" />

As Skywalker walked out of the base toward the First Order, Minnau rose from behind one of the baricades alongside fellow Resistance members [[Salaka Kuchimba]] and [[Koo Millham]], staring in confusion at the [[Jedi]]. Skywalker, who was in fact [[Force projection|Force projecting]] from the planet [[Ahch-To]], then confronted the forces of the First Order and its [[Supreme Leader]], [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]], alone in order to buy the surviving Resistance members [[time]] to escape. After following [[vulptex]]s through a hidden tunnel out of the base,<ref name="TLJ" /> all<ref name="Battles">''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]''</ref> of the surviving Resistance members were picked up by the [[YT-1300 light freighter]] known as the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' and escaped from Crait.<ref name="TLJ" /> Minnau shared his surname<ref name="TLJVD" /> with [[Teckla Minnau]], a [[handmaiden]] from the planet [[Naboo]].<ref name="POP">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Minnau had fair skin, [[Color|graying]] brown [[hair]], and blue [[eye]]s.<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Equipment==
Minnau wore a brown [[Clothing|uniform]] that included a Resistance combat [[helmet]], brown [[boot]]s, [[glove]]s, and a [[belt]]. He also used a [[bandolier]] of pouches and carried a [[EL-16 blaster rifle]].<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Saile Minnau appeared in the [[2017]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']].<ref name="TLJ" /> The character was portrayed by [[Nathan Hamill]], who appeared in a cameo alongside his siblings, [[Griffin Hamill]] and [[Chelsea Hamill]], who portrayed Kuchimba and Millham respectively.<ref name="Tumblr">{{Tumblr|subdomain=nathanhamill|url=post/168627377806/my-character-saile-minnau-in-the-star-wars-the|name=Moon Jockey|text=Saile Minnau}}</ref> The trio are shown staring at the return of Luke Skywalker,<ref name="TLJ" /> who is portrayed by their father, [[Mark Hamill]].<ref name="Father">{{SW|url=news/the-last-jedi-speaks|text=The Last Jedi Speaks}}</ref>

Nathan Hamill's character was not named in the film,<ref name="TLJ" /> but received identification in ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> and released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-star-wars-the-last-jedi-books-and-more-revealed-at-sdcc-2017|text=New ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Books and More Revealed at SDCC 2017}}</ref> Hamill previously portrayed a character in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], who he named [[Rehtul Minnau]],<ref name="Tumblr" /> a name that was later used in official sources but not tied explicitly to Hamill's character in the film.<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|teckla|Minnau, Teckla}}</ref> Hamill has stated that he considers Rehtul to be Saile's grandfather due to their shared surname.<ref name="Tumblr" />
